The Ground Truth Answer specifies the earthquake's magnitude as "Mw 9.0–9.1." The Predicted Answer states the earthquake was of "magnitude 9.0." Although the Predicted Answer does not mention the full range (9.0–9.1), it provides the "9.0" value, which matches the lower bound of the ground truth. Both answers refer to the same major event (the Great East Japan Earthquake) and the essential fact — an earthquake of about magnitude 9.0 — is present. The slight omission of the upper bound does not remove the core accuracy of the answer, as "9.0" is within "9.0–9.1."
